card.name: Section and page numbers in references
card.fires_on: Numbers or roman numerals that start a section, paragraph, page or figure reference, such as the 1 in a numbered clause or the digit after 'page', 'Diagram' or a section heading.

modes.label: Paragraph numbering
modes.description: A digit that begins a numbered clause or paragraph, often just before a decimal point.
modes.example: Taxes, regulation and other policy instruments <<5>>.7 The Government will explore the scope

modes.label: Cross-reference numbers
modes.description: A number after page, diagram, or guideline that points the reader to another place in the text.

modes.label: Roman numeral headings
modes.description: A roman numeral that starts a new section heading.

card.writes: It favors outline and reference markers such as appendix, figure, and roman numerals, and suppresses programming length terms like len and sizeof.
card.plain: It fires on the number that labels a section, page or figure, as in 'see page 10' or '5.7'.
